Phonetic Alphabet

छह

The ICAO/FAA radiotelephony spelling for the numeral '6'. Used for unambiguous communication of headings, altitudes, frequencies, and runways in ATC phraseology.

Questions and answers

What is छह?

In this glossary, छह refers to: The ICAO/FAA radiotelephony spelling for the numeral '6'. Used for unambiguous communication of headings, altitudes, frequencies, and runways in ATC phraseology.

Definition

The ICAO/FAA radiotelephony spelling for the numeral '6'. Used for unambiguous communication of headings, altitudes, frequencies, and runways in ATC phraseology.

Operational example

Maintain heading two four six, descend and maintain six thousand feet.

Localized term
